verses.text: “If one of y’all brings Yahweh a peace offering from the herd, male or female, bring an animal with no defects. 🐂
Put your hand on the animal’s head and slaughter it at the Meeting Tent entrance. Aaron’s sons, the priests, will splash its blood all around the altar. 🩸
From the peace offering, set aside a fire offering for Yahweh: the fat covering the inner organs and all the fat attached to them, 🔥
both kidneys with their fat near the loins, and the liver’s covering, which you remove along with the kidneys. 🐂
Aaron’s sons will burn these on the altar, over the burnt offering and the wood on the fire. It’s a fire offering, with an aroma pleasing to Yahweh. 🔥
“If your peace offering to Yahweh comes from the flock, male or female, bring one with no defects. 🐑
If you’re bringing a lamb, present it before Yahweh. 🐑
Put your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Meeting Tent. Aaron’s sons will splash its blood all around the altar. 🩸
From the peace offering, set aside a fire offering for Yahweh. Remove the fat—including the whole fat tail close to the backbone—and all the fat covering the inner organs, 🔥
both kidneys with their fat near the loins, and the liver’s covering, which you remove along with the kidneys. 🐑
The priest will burn these on the altar as food from Yahweh’s fire offering. 🍽️
“If your offering’s a goat, bring it before Yahweh. 🐐
Put your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Meeting Tent. Aaron’s sons will splash its blood all around the altar. 🩸
Set this aside from the goat as a fire offering to Yahweh: the fat covering the inner organs and all the fat attached to them, 🔥
both kidneys with their fat near the loins, and the liver’s covering, which you remove along with the kidneys. 🐐
The priest will burn these on the altar as food for the fire offering, a pleasing aroma. All the fat belongs to Yahweh. 🔥
“This is the lasting rule for every generation, wherever y’all live: don’t eat fat or blood.” 🕊️
